column3: The hooded IT ninja stands confidently in three-quarter view on the right side, one hand resting on a large glowing lime-green price tag shape made of thin circuit lines (the tag is blank, no text), beside a small floating calculator hologram. The top 55% of the frame is mostly empty dark purple space with subtle particles (a title will be placed there later).

The hooded IT ninja sits at a desk in a dark office, frozen and hesitant, looking at a big glowing lime-green question mark shape floating in front of him (a pure geometric shape, not a typed character), a laptop open with abstract lines. Subject on the right half, left half empty dark space.

Across a dark meeting table: on the left the silhouette of a business owner in a suit seen from behind (no face visible), on the right the hooded IT ninja; between them on the table a small glowing miniature office building connected by thin lime light lines to a tiny server and computers. Calm, trustworthy conversation mood.

A large glowing hourglass whose sand is made of tiny lime-green light particles, fused with a minimalist clock ring behind it, next to a sleek dark calculator and a short neat stack of dark coins with lime edges. Product-shot composition, subject centered-right.

Three glowing lime-green light paths start from a single bright point at the bottom left and diverge to the right, each path ending at a different floating object: a stopwatch, a neat stack of three small computer monitors, and a closed folder with a seal (a contract). Isometric, elegant, lots of dark space.

Isometric view of a small office network (one server, a firewall box, a router and four computers) enclosed by a crisp glowing lime-green boundary line of light on the floor like a fence; outside the boundary, a few dim floating boxes and blueprints drift in the purple darkness (projects left out of scope).

Three floating glowing status beacons of decreasing size and brightness in a row (large intense lime beacon with alert rings, medium beacon, small calm beacon), each with a thin circular timer ring around it, over a dark reflective floor. Clear hierarchy of urgency.

A single elegant sheet of paper floating at a slight angle, glowing softly with lime edges, covered only in abstract horizontal lines and a few small boxes (no text), a sleek pen beside it, and a gloved ninja hand presenting it from the right. Shallow depth of field.

The hooded IT ninja inside a modern small office at a workstation, wearing an employee ID badge on a lanyard (badge blank), surrounded by connected equipment glowing with thin lime lines: a server rack, a printer, desk phones and several computers, as if he alone holds the whole office IT together.
